name: HBCD_ECG_Pipeline
author: Columbia University, Department of Psychiatry
description: The HBCD ECG Pipeline automatically identifies the most likely ECG channel among E125-E128 (using NeuroKit R-peak counts plus a direct correlation-matrix check) and then runs the full ECG QC, RR, HR, and HRV pipeline on the selected channel for each subject/session/task found in a BIDS directory. Files for which no ECG channel can be confidently identified are skipped and logged.

inputs.description: The study-wide BIDS directory. In CBRAIN this is also referred to (and used) as the subject directory since a new BIDS dir will be made for the selected subject prior to processing.
inputs.name: Subject Directory

inputs.description: Name/path of the output directory where preprocessing results, QC figures, and summary CSVs will be saved.
inputs.name: ECG Output Directory Name

inputs.description: Level of analysis to run. Only participant_level is currently supported by the pipeline.
inputs.name: Analysis Level

inputs.description: Space-delimited list of participant labels to process (with or without the sub- prefix). If omitted, all subjects found in SubjectDirectory are processed.
inputs.name: Participant Label

inputs.description: Space-delimited list of session labels to process (with or without the ses- prefix). If omitted, all sessions found in SubjectDirectory are processed.
inputs.name: Session Label

inputs.description: Task(s) to process, e.g. RS, or RS MMN FACE VEP for multiple tasks.
inputs.name: Tasks

inputs.description: Acquisition label to process; matches acq-<value> in the BIDS filenames. Default is 'ecg'.
inputs.name: Acquisition Label

inputs.description: ECG quality cutoff (template-match correlation) used for high-quality segment detection. Default is 0.95.
inputs.name: Quality Threshold

inputs.description: Seconds before/after event markers to show in the marker QC plots. Default is 10.
inputs.name: QC Window Seconds

output-files.name: Output Directory
output-files.description: Directory containing per-subject/session/task ECG QC figures, HRV outputs, and summary CSVs.
